windows.label: main
windows.title: Lumen S1 shell
windows.// transparent: Required: mpv renders into this same window via --wid, underneath the WebView. An opaque WebView background would cover the video entirely and the run would measure a black rectangle.
windows.// shadow: A window shadow on a fullscreen transparent window costs the compositor a blur pass for nothing.
windows.// dragDropEnabled: Off because the drag-drop handler installs an OS-level subclass on the window that interferes with the embedded child surface on Windows.

bundle.// active: No installer is produced. The harness runs the binary from target/release directly.
